faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: You can return any product within 30 days of purchase for a full refund.

faqs.question: How do I track my order?
faqs.answer: Visit the Orders section in your account and click Track to see real-time updates.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept credit cards, debit cards, UPI, and net banking.

faqs.question: How do I contact customer support?
faqs.answer: You can reach us at support@example.com or call 1800-123-456.

faqs.question: Can I change my order after placing it?
faqs.answer: Orders can be modified within 1 hour of placement. Contact support immediately.

faqs.question: Do you offer free shipping?
faqs.answer: Yes, free shipping is available on all orders above Rs. 499.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days depending on your location.

faqs.question: Is my payment information secure?
faqs.answer: Yes, all payments are encrypted using SSL and we never store card details.
